neighbours.label: the token ' unlucky'
fire: Many people think that Friday the thirteenth is an unlucky day.
The striker was unlucky not to score in the second half.
It was an unlucky break that ended her skiing career.
Our neighbors have been unlucky with their old car this year.
Some sailors believe whistling on deck is unlucky for the voyage.
The unlucky tourist lost his wallet on the first day.
He felt unlucky after the third flat tire in a week.
The farmers had an unlucky season with hail in June.
quiet: Many people think that Friday the thirteenth is a lucky day.
The striker was unable to score in the second half.
It was an unfortunate break that ended her skiing career.
Our neighbors have been unhappy with their old car this year.
Some sailors believe whistling on deck brings bad weather for the voyage.
The tired tourist lost his wallet on the first day.
He felt annoyed after the third flat tire in a week.
The farmers had a difficult season with hail in June.

notes: Card (max 2.48): 6 of the top 10 are ' unlucky'; also ' luck' and stray pieces. Probe: 'an unlucky number' 0.751, 'was unlucky to lose' 0.675, 'been unlucky with injuries' 0.430; 'Bad luck' 0.044, 'unfortunate' 0.030, 'lucky' 0.045, bare 'unlucky' with no space 0.026.
